exposure: Hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection in mothers
finding: HCV-infected mothers had a higher frequency of anemia, cesarean sections, nuchal cords, and their neonates had lower birth weights and smaller head circumferences.
mod_finding: Hepatitis C virus (HCV)-infected mothers had a higher frequency of medical conditions that required caesarian section compared to healthy mothers.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight in HCV group: 3105.1 ± 459.4 grams, Control group: 3278.3 ± 462.0 grams
